Commentary.Commentary: We are back. The players are out in the middle. Shubman Gill and Shikhar Dhawan to open for India. Kagiso Rabada has the ball in his hand. All set. Let's play...
...THE CHASE...

Now this could be a stiff chase, the wicket is not easy to bat on and South Africa have a quality bowling attack. India though have batters who are familiar to these conditions. The second half promises to be an exciting one.

India will be disappointed with their performance. There was turn, bounce and swing but they could not make most of the conditions. We believe the new ball bowlers were a tad short and Ravi Bishnoi just was not at his best. Thakur and Kuldeep bowled well but the rest weren't upto the mark. The fielding was also not at its best or South Africa could have well ended below 240. Both the batters were dropped in the back end on consecutive deliveries and they made the most of the given lifeline.

It wasn't easy going for the visitors though. A lot of credit has to be given to their openers who weathered the storm earlier on and got them to a sedate start. They did lose three after that and were in trouble but Miller, Klaasen and Quinton de Kock played really well to get them to the score they did. Klaasen and de Kock bailed them out of trouble and then came the stand which has given South Africa the edge, A 100-plus run partnership between Klaasen and Miller with both scoring fifties.

A really good show with the bat on what seems a sluggish wicket by South Africa. That stand between David Miller and Heinrich Klaasen has probably given the edge to the visitors heading into the break.
Apart from the first ball, it is excellent over from Siraj! This is short and on middle, cramped Heinrich Klaasen for room as he looks to pull. South Africa end at 249/4.
On middle, this is hit to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, way outside off. Miller slashes and misses.
Width given, outside off. Miller cuts it to deep cover where the fielder runs to his right, dives and parries it across to the deep point fielder. Excellent work in the deep. Two runs.
A widish yorker, outside off. Miller fails to squeeze it out. Much better from Siraj.
SIX! A perfect start to the final over! Shorter and outside off. Miller slashes on the up and over deep cover for a biggie.
A single to end the over as this is worked to long on.
Flatter and on middle. Klaasen smacks it to long on for a single.
Full toss on middle. Klaasen again plays the reverse sweep but fins short third man.
FOUR! What a shot! This is full and outside off. Klaasen reverse hits it well over short third man for a boundary.
On middle. Klaasen plays a mistimed lofted shot to long on for a brace.
Leg bye! Flatter, quicker, around leg. Miller misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but it was pitching outside leg.
Klaasen makes room, this outside off. Klaasen slashes and misses. Two drop catches, 16 runs in total. An eventful over.
Outside off, worked to point for a single.
SIX MORE! Miller has pressed the accelerator! Outside off on a length and Miller pulls it well this time over mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! A widish full toss, outside off. Miller drives it through point for a boundary.

DROPPED! AGAIN! Both the batters get a lifeline! Not a good thing by India! Short of a length and outside off. Miller pulls, it goes off the top edge to deep square leg where Ravi Bishnoi fails to hold on. Two runs.

Siraj drops the skier! It went way, way up in the air! This is full and outside off. Klaasen steps across as he tries to heave but mistimes it high in the air. The ball goes to deep mid-wicket where Mohammed Siraj fails to take the skier. Three runs taken.
On middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Siraj pushes it through, outside off. Klaasen looks to drive but misses.
FOUR! both the batters after scoring fifty are going for the big shots! This is short and way outside off. Klaasen upper cuts it over backward point for a boundary.
This one stays low, outside off. Klaasen swings and misses.
On middle, on a length. Klaasen scoops it over fine leg for a couple.

Well done in the end from Ruturaj Gaikwad! This is short and on middle. Miller pulls it to deep mid-wicket, flat and Ruturaj Gaikwad runs in to take the catch but the ball was dipping and that made it hard for the fielder to collect. A single.
SIX! Klaasen changes the gears now. This is very full and outside off. Klaasen makes room and goes inside-out over covers for a biggie.

Fifty for Klaasen! This is short and on middle. Klaasen pulls it to fine leg for a couple of runs. There is a direct hit at his end but the replay shows Klaasen had his bat in. A fine innings from Klaasen. His 4th ODI fifty.
Shorter and on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and outside off. Klaasen drops it in front of covers for a quick single.

Outside off, Miller guides it gently to point for a quick single. That brings up the fifty for Killer Miller! Came when his team lost a couple of wickets in quick time but has settled the nerves since then and is all set to take his team to a competitive total.
Wide! Too many extras from India! A bouncer on middle and the umpire calls it a wide.
Short in length and around off. Miller carves it to bckward point.
On middle, this is pulled to deep square leg for a single. Miller moves to 49.
Wide! A slower bouncer going down leg. Left alone.
Outside off, punched to cover.
FOUR!  A welcome boundary for the Proteas! Short of a length and on middle. Miller pulls it gently and finds the gap to deep mid-wicket for four.
On the pads, flicked behind square leg for a single.
On the hips, worked to deep square leg for a single.
This is outside and on the shorter side. Miller slashes and misses due to the extra bounce.
Length and outside off. Klaasen drops it around the corner on the off side. He wants a quick single but Miller is not interested.
Outside off this is dabbed to third man for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Klaasen pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, pinched to mid off for a single.
This one is angled outside off. Miller looks to push but misses.
An appeal for LBW but not given! A length ball on middle, and it skids through. Miller looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. Might be just going down.
Shorter and outside off. Miller slaps it hard and to cover where Iyer makes a half stop. Only a single.
Flatter and outside off. Klaasen cuts it through point for a single.
This one lands around off and spins away. Klaasen looks to slog-sweep but misses.
Around off, kept out.
Uppish but safe! This is short and around off, a bit slower. Klaasen looks to pull but top edges it and the ball lands safely in the vacant mid-wicket region.
Tossed up on off. Miller plays with soft hands to point for a sharp single.
Tidy start to the new spell from Siraj! Just 6 runs off it. On a length and on middle, nudged to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short again from Siraj, this is dabbed to third man for one.
Slower, short in length and it is pulled to fine leg for a single.
Outside off, tapped to covers for a sharp single.
Too full and on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Good fielding by Ravi Bishnoi in the deep.
On middle, pushed to covers for a single.

FOUR! Shardul Thakur comes around the wicket and angles it down the leg side, making it easy for Miller who tickles it to fine leg for a boundary. South Africa will look for a score around 260-270 from here with these two all set for a big score.
A length ball, outside off. Defended out.
On middle on the short side. Miller controls his pull shot to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Length ball on middle. Klaasen nudges it past mid-wicket for one more.
Bangs a short ball on middle, Miller pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Outside off, guided to backward point for a single.
Klaasen retains the strike as he hits through to deep mid-wicket.
SIX! Wonderful shot! Tossed up, full and outside off. Klaasen lofts it firmly over covers and all the way for a six.
Shorter and turning around leg. Klaasen clears his front leg to pull but gets hit on the pads.
On middle. Miller reverse sweeps it through point for a single.
Full, slow and outside off. Miller looks to push but misses.
A single as this is hit to deep square leg.
Quicker one on middle. Miller punches it back foot back to the bowler.
Klaasen plays it through the line to long off for a single.
FOUR! Klaasen connects it well! This is short and on leg. Klaasen opens up his body and pulls it to deep mid-wicket.
THREE RED! VERY WELL PLAYED! Flatter and outside off. Miller punches off the back foot past point. Kuldeep Yadav gives a chase and saves a run for his team.
Slanting on middle, nudged to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Klaasen chops it to point.
Outside off again, spinning away. Left alone.
Outside off, slapped to covers.

Again huge turn! Full and on middle, flighted and it turns away. Miller looks to sweep but misses. Samson clips the bails off. It is taken upstairs. No bat there and the replay shows Miller had his back foot grounded all time.
This one lands on middle, and spins away sharrply. Miller has a poke at it but misses.
On middle. Defended out.
On middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.

IN THE AIR AND FALLS SAFELY! A chance goes by for India! Should have been taken! This is full, slow and outside off. Miller toe ends his lot and hits it high in the air. The ball goes to the cover region. Shikhar Dhawan runs back from cover while Avesh Khan runs in from long off. Khan had a better chance but Dhawan went in with a big dive. Two runs.
On middle. Miller punches it to covers.
Touch short and outside off. Klaasen pulls it flat to deep mid-wicket. One more.
Outside off, guided to backward point for a single.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Leg bye! This is full, slow and on leg. Miller misses his heave and it goes off the pads to cover. One.
Wide! This is way dow the leg side. Miller looks to sweep but misses.
Length ball on middle. Klaasen tickles it to deep square leg. A better throw from Avesh Khan could have made it interesting. Two runs.
Another short ball, this onne is at 131 clicks. Klaasen evades it.
On the hips, bunted to fine leg for a single.
Wide! A bumper now, too short and the umpire calls it a wide.
This is full and angling outside off. Miller is tempted to drive but is a bit early and he misses.
Bowls it on top of off. Miller knocks it to cover.
On a length and outside off, Miller mistimes his punch to covers.
Flatter ball, outside off. Klaasen drops it to cover.
Just outside off. Klaasen dabs it to point.
On middle, nudged through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! BANG! Effortless shot from Miller! Rabi flights this too much and gives ample time to Miller to use his feet and loft it over long off for a biggie.
Another single as this is hit to deep square leg.
Floats one on full. and on middle. Miller plays it to deep square leg for one.
Full ball, on middle, Miller bunts it to square leg for a single.
A stock delivery, full and outside off. Kept out.
Too full and on off. Defended on the front foot.
On middle, Miller reverse sweeps it to deep point for a brace.
What a delivery! This one is angled around off and it spins sharply away. Across Miller. The ball beats the outside edge and flies past the keeper and over slip for a couple of byes.
FOUR! Another one for Miller! Tossed up, outside off. Miller sweeps it hard through square leg for four. He is a good player of spin.
Tossed up on off. Miller prods and taps it to covers for a single.
FOUR! Miller is off the mark! Short and too much width. Miller slaps off the back foot through covers for a boundary.
A googly now, outside off, punched to covers.
Wide! This is down the leg side. Wided.
On middle. Blocked out.

OUT! LBW! THREE REDS! The set batter goes now and South Africa are in massive trouble. Ravi Bishnoi will be relived by picking this wicket. He was going for runs. He slows it up and bowls in line with the stumps. Quinton de Kock looks to reverse sweep but misses and gets pinged on the pads. An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. De Kock is quick to review this. Ultra Edge shows no bat while Ball Tracking shows THREE REDS. De Kock has to go now.
Two leg byes! Ravi Bishnoi is still struggling with his line! This is down the leg side. De Kock misses his flick and it goes off the pads to fine leg for a couple.
Tossed up, outside off and spins in. Heinrich Klaasen looks to reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
This one spins away, full and on off. De Kock looks to work on the leg side but gets a leading edge to point. One.
Fuller and on middle. Blocked on the front foot.
Very full and on middle. Heinrich Klaasen sweeps it behind square leg for one.
On middle, fuller, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and around off. De Kock reverse sweeps it straight to short third man.
FOUR! 13 runs off the over! A bouncer. Heinrich Klaasen looks to evade but gets some part of bat on it. It flies off the top edge over the keeper for four runs.
Bangs a bouncer on middle, this one stays low and hits Heinrich Klaasen on the body as he tries to duck.
Wide! Short in length but again angling down the leg side. Left alone for a wide.
On middle, tucked to square leg for a single.
Wide! Tries a slower one but serves it down the leg side. De Kock misses his flick.
Angling on the pads, clipped to deep square leg for a single.
This is full and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Cheeky! A length ball, outside off. De Kock shuffles across and paddles it fine to fine leg for a boundary.
On middle, kept out.
Half an appeal but the impact is outside off. Heinrich Klaasen looks to play the reverse sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.
This is pushed through, on middle, defended.
FOUR! That is a strong shot! Really good sweep. This is flighted around off, Klaasen sweeps it through square leg and the ball races away to the fence.
Bowls a full toss, Kuldeep looks to fire it in but ends up bowling a full, it is swept wide of deep mid-wicket for two.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Fuller and outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Uppish but wide of mid on! On middle, fuller, this is clipped past the mid on fielder and into the fence.
Just outside off, another leave.
On the pads, this is worked to mid on.
In the 5th stump channel, just outside off, Heinrich Klaasen plays inside the line and is beaten.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, not played at.
Good length and on off, defended.
De Kock opts for the reverse sweep again, this is played behind square on the off side. Two taken.
Heinrich Klaasen plays the reverse sweep, there is a deep point in place so only one.
Out comes the reverse sweep, it is not timed that well but hits it through square leg for one.
That is a beauty! This is tossed up on off, it lands and spins away. De Kock is beaten as he tries to defend.
Top edge but lands safe! On middle, Heinrich Klaasen looks to play the paddle scoop, it goes off the top edge towards short fine leg for one.
A full toss, de Kock works it through square leg for one.
A dot to end! On the stumps, blocked.
Drop and run! Length and on off, de Kock plays it towads point and gets to the other end.
Heinrich Klaasen is off the mark! Fuller and on off, this is pushed towards mid off for a quick run.
Another one on the stumps, kept out.
On middle, defended.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Heinrich Klaasen comes in.

OUT! TIMBER! That is a beauty! What an over from Kudeep and he strikes on the last ball. Markram walks back for a duck and all of a sudden, South Africa are in trouble. This is tossed up outside off, Markram is drawn forward as he tries to defend. The ball lands and turns back in. Sneaks between the gap of bat and pad and hits the stumps.
And again, does not pick which way the ball is turning! This lands on off and then spins back in a long way. Markram looks to push it on the off side but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Flatter and around off, Markram guides it to point.
Markram has not picked that one! This lands on middle and it is the googly. Markram looks to defend but is beaten.
Leading edge but safe! That one held in the surface and also spun! This lands on pads, it turns away. Markram is early in the flick, it goes off the leading edge but lands wide of the bowler.
On middle, de Kock works it through square leg and takes one.
Aiden Markram walks out now.

OUT! TIMBER! Thakur gets another one! The South Africa skippe walks back for another low score and the visitors lose two in quick succession. This is on a length, just outside off, it lands and jags back in sharply. Bavuma looks to play at it but leaves a big gap between bat and pad as he tries to do so. The ball sneaks through and hits the off pole.
Bangs it short and on the body, de Kock pulls it through square leg and gets to the other end.
That was a little too close to cut! Just outside off, fractionally short. De Kock looks to cut but is beaten.
Back of a length and on off, kept out.
Fuller and on off, this is driven but to mid off.

FOUR! Off the inside edge! Runs starting to flow now for South Africa. This one a fortunate boundary! Length and outside off, de Kock pushes at it, it goes off the inside edge past the leg pole and down to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! That is a huge over for South Africa! 16 from it. Nice placement from Bavuma! This is full and outside off, Bavuma squeezes it past point and this one races away to the fence.
On middle, Bavuma works it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! An appeal but that was to probably put the umpire off! Down the leg side. Bavuma looks to pull but misses. Wided.
Bavuma misses out! He does not connect on the Free Hit! It is fired outside off. Bavuma looks to go over cover but misses.

FOUR! Really good way to get off the mark! Will take the pressure off him! On middle, the reverse sweep is out and it is played nicely behind point for a boundary. ALSO, the siren goes on which means it is a NO BALL! Free Hit coming up.
Flatter and on off, Bavuma blocks.
BEATEN! A little bit of turn! This lands around off and spins away. Bavuma looks to defend but is beaten.
On middle, it is an easy single as there is not mid-wicket. De Kock works it through that region.
FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs and the fifty is up! Down the leg side. De Kock leaves it alone. The keeper fails to take it cleanly and it races away to the fence.
Angled into middle, Temba Bavuma lunges and defends it.
Solid from Bavuma! Length and on off, kept out.
Shorter and on off, Bavuma pushes it to covers.
Good length and on off, defended.
Good length and on off, defended.

Drinks! South Africa have got a good start and despite losing Malan, they will look to score at the same run and keep the momentum. India have done nothing wrong so far and will look to keep it tight and look for wickets. Temba Bavuma joins De Kock in the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Shardul Thakur gets his man and India manage to break the opening stand! A soft dismissal. Malan weathered the storm earlier on and gets out to probably the least threatening delivery. This is full and on the pads, it probably holds in the surface a touch. Malan looks to work it through square leg but since he was early in the shot, it goes uppishly towards mid-wicket. Iyer leaps and takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Shreyas Iyer b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: Half an appeal but turned down! That seemed off the glove! Around off, de Kock looks to play the reverse sweep but misses to get hit on the glove.
Two more! Good running again! On middle, this is flicked wide of long on for two.
That is smart batting! The short fine leg was moved on the off side. De Kock plays the paddle scoop fine on the leg side for two.
Flatter and outside off, the reverse sweep comes out again but de Kock misses.
De Kock is really going after Ravi Bishnoi! Now plays the reverse sweep, it is a low full toss on off. Finds the man at short third man.
On off, Malan pushes it through covers for one.
Length again and on off, Malan pushes it through cover for one more.
Slightly fuller and on off, Malan strokes it to covers.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed to cover.
On the pads, de Kock works it towards square leg and gets to the other end.
Another short one and on middle, Malan gets on top of the bounce and pulls it down to fine leg for one.
Angled into the pads, Malan looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
A dot to end but an expensive start for Ravi Bishnoi! On off, defended.
The googly on the pads, this is clipped through square leg for one.
Keeps it short and outside off, de Kock slaps it through covers for one.

FOUR! That is timed brilliantly! Made a cracking sound of the bat. Outside off, de Kock plays the sweep and hits it fine behind square on the leg side for a boundary. 8 from the first three balls. Ravi Bishnoi under pressure.
On off, lands it well. Defended.

FOUR! A boundary to welcome Ravi Bishnoi! That went through the legs of Dhawan! Flatter and on off, this one skids through. De Kock plays it late. It goes between the legs of Dhawan who is late in getting down. Boundary. Welcome one again.
Shorter and outside off, Malan chops it towards cover. Could have been a wicket-taking over for Thakur but it is still a good one, only three from it.
Just outside off, left alone.
Back of a length and on middle, this one takes off after landing. De Kock looks to defend, it goes off the splice towards the leg side for one.
Shorter and outside off, Malan slaps it through covers but only one as there is protection in the deep.

DROPPED! That was a regulation slip catch for Gill but he puts it down! Thakur could have made an immediate impact! Length and on off, Malan looks to push at it with hard hands. It goes off the outside edge and goes towards Gill at widish first slip. He spills it. This could prove costly.
Bangs it short and on the body, de Kock is late on the pull, it goes off the glove and towards square leg for one. De Kock is disappointed he did not score more on that delivery.
End of Powerplay 1! Now, 4 fielders are allowed outside the circle. Also, Shardul Thakur is into the attack.
Two to end! Length and on off, this one jags back in. Malan looks to defend, it goes off the inner half through square leg for two.
Two leaves in a row as this is also wide outside off.
Another one wide outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Malan has no problem in putting the short ball away! A welcome boundary for South Africa. Avesh changes his length and goes short. Malan rocks back and pulls it through square leg and into the fence.
Finds the fielder! Need to put such deliveries away when runs are hard to comeby! Fuller and outside off, Malan drives it crisply but to cover.
Really good stuff from the Indian bowlers, giving nothing away. Length and on off, this lands and jags back in. Malan looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
A lot of swing again! Length and on off, this lands and moves away a lot. Even more after it passes the bat of de Kock. Samson dives to his left and takes it.
Angled into the pads, Malan works it towards mid on and gets to the other end.
Back of a length and on off, Malan pushes it to cover.
WIDE! That seemed like a slower bumper, does hold in the surface a touch but it is down the leg side. Wided.
Good length and on off, Malan plays it to covers.
Fuller and on middle, Malan plays it to mid on.
Still a lot of movement for the bowlers! Length and on middle, this lands and jags back in. Malan is beaten as he tries to defend and gets hit on the thigh pad.
A tidy over then from Avesh! On middle, it is kept out well.
Length and on off, de Kock defends.
Almost! This is slightly fuller and outside off, Quinton de Kock looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Finds the gap! A little too short from Avesh! It is outside off, de Kock pushes it past cover. The outfield is a touch slow. Two taken.
Back of a length and on off, de Kock plays it late but finds point.
Good length and on off, de Kock defends.
FOUR! Pulled away! Yet again Siraj's over ends with a boundary! Not really sure if he needed to bowl that length. This is short and on the body. Malan pulls it down to the fine leg fence.
Good length and on off, Malan guides it to point.
Lovely! Now gets the ball to come back in but does so from a little too wide outside off. Left alone again.
Outside off, quite wide outside off, easy leave.
A little too straight, de Kock clips it down to fine leg and takes one.
Lovely stuff! Length and on off, this lands and moves away again. De Kock is beaten as he tries to block. A lot of movement for the bowlers out there.
Another jaffa! Can't do a lot with that! This is angled into the off pole, it lands and moves away. Malan looks to play it with the full face of the bat but is beaten.
Outside off, left alone. Testing times for the South African batters, they need to get past this and one assumes batting will get easier.
Half an appeal but turned down! A lot of movement again! Length and outside off, this lands and jags back in. Malan looks to defend but misses to get hit high on the pads.
On the pads, de Kock works it down to fine leg for one.
Another lovely nut! Length again and on middle, this lands and moves away. De Kock is beaten again as he tries to defend.
Another lovely delivery! The Indian pacers are getting some good movement here! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. De Kock is beaten.

FOUR! Exquisite! What a shot that is. What a response to the previous deliveries. This should give Malan a lot of confidence. He was beaten at least twice in this over. Siraj bowls yet another length ball on off, Malan takes a stride forward and caresses it through covers. A good way to end the over.

That is unplayable! Just unplayable! Lovely! Malan takes a few steps down the track but Siraj shortens the length. This starts on off and then shapes away. Malan is squared up as he tries to block, it goes past the outside edge yet again.
Another beauty! Well played in the end though. Another one on a length and around off, moves away after landing. Malan initially looks to play at it but then bails out of the shot.
That is a beauty! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Malan looks to defend but is beaten.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Malan does not fiddle with it.
Just outside off, a little bit of swing away. Left alone.
BEATEN! Superb start from India so far! Short of a length and angling across the left-hander. De Kock looks to defend but is beaten.
FOUR! First boundary off the innings. Too full from Khan, on off and it is driven beautifully straight down for four runs.
This one has extra pace on it, on a length and around off, curves in. De Kock looks to defend but gets squared up and gets hit on the thigh front pad. He looks a bit in pain but gets up quickly.
Pitched up, around off. De Kock drives it past the diving mid off fielder for a couple of runs. De Kock is off the mark as well.
Bit of width, outside off, pushed to mid off.
A stifled appeal but the height was an issue. On a length and on middle, jags in a bit. De Kock shuffles as he looks to defend but gets hit high on the pads.
Avesh Khan to start from the other end.
On a length and outside off, Malan knocks it to cover.
This one straightens off the deck. On a length and outside off. Malan looks to push but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short of a length and outside off. Malan punches off the back foot through point for a couple of runs. South Africa and Malan are underway.
On middle. Blocked out.

A length ball, around off and it shapes away off the deck. Malan is squared up as he looks to defend. He plays inside the line and gets pinged on the pads. A huge appeal for LBW but the umpire doesn't move. India take the review. Now then, that looked very close. Ultra Edge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows impact is the umpire's call and the ball goes onto hit the top of off, umpire's call and Malan survives. Beauty of delivery from Siraj.
A length ball, outside off, Malan shoulders arms to it.

We are all set for the action. The two umpires are out in the middle. Now, the Indian players make their way out. Janneman Malan and Quinton de Kock to open for South Africa. VVS Laxman rings the bell at the stadium. Mohammed Siraj to start with the ball. Two slips for Malan. Here we go...

South Africa (Playing XI) - Janneman Malan, Quinton de Kock (WK), Temba Bavuma (C), Aiden Markram, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller, Wayne Parnell, Keshav Maharaj, Kagiso Rabada, Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi.

India (Playing XI) - Shikhar Dhawan (C), Shubman Gill, Ruturaj Gaikwad (ON HIS DEBUT), Ishan Kishan, Shreyas Iyer, Sanju Samson (WK), Shardul Thakur, Kuldeep Yadav, Ravi Bishnoi (ON HIS DEBUT), Mohammed Siraj, Avesh Khan.

Temba Bavuma, the skipper of South Africa says they would've bowled first. Adds it is difficult to assess the pitch but they have a job to do now. Tells they need to adapt to different formats quickly and tells with few overs lost now, they have to keep T20 skills in check. Ends by informing his team.
